config_file.description: Full path of a config file.

log_level.description: Set log level by value or name. Choices: 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 'DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR', 'CRITICAL'

ip.description: The IP address the Jupyter server will listen on.

port.description: The port the Jupyter server will listen on.

port_retries.description: The number of additional ports to try if the specified port is not available.

root_dir.description: The directory to use for notebooks and kernels.

allow_root.description: Allow the server to be run from root user.

open_browser.description: Prevent the opening of the default url in the browser.

keyfile.description: The full path to a private key file for usage with SSL/TLS.

certfile.description: The full path to an SSL/TLS certificate file.

client_ca.description: The full path to a certificate authority certificate for SSL/TLS client authentication.

gateway_url.description: The url of the Kernel or Enterprise Gateway server.

browser.description: Specify what command to use to invoke a web browser.

pylab.description: DISABLED: use %pylab or %matplotlib in the notebook.

extensions.description: List of extension names to load.

environment_vars.description: List of environment variables to set for the server process. Each item is a flat map of name/value pairs.

environment_vars.items.description: Placeholder for items type in environment_vars list.
